rules.text: Use when entering Combat. All of your opponent's
Personalities lose 2 stages. Banish after use.
All attacks cost +1 stage to perform and do +2 life cards of damage.
Energy attack costing 2 stages.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards; 10 life cards instead if your
opponent has 10 or fewer cards in their Life Deck.
Villains only. POWER: If Cell is anywhere
in play, search your Life Deck for 3 Allies
and place them in play at 5 stages above 0.
All attacks performed by Allies do +2 stages of damage.
Cell only. POWER: Your attacks performed by
Cell do +3 life cards of damage this Combat.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Physical attack.
DAMAGE: AT +2 stages and +1 life card
per Cell Jr. you have in play.
POWER: If your Main Personality is Krillin at Level
1, gain 6 anger. You cannot win by Most Powerful
Personality Victory for the rest of the game.
POWER: Setups and Drills cannot be
used this Combat. Search your Life Deck
for a Freestyle Drill and place it in play.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Vegeta only.
POWER: Search your Life Deck for 3 Vegeta
Named cards and place them in your hand.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages.
HIT: Shuffle all Drills in play into their
owners' Life Decks. Banish after use.
Vegeta only. POWER: Raise Vegeta
to his highest stage. Raise your
anger 1 level. Banish after use.
POWER: Choose a Personality, Setup or
Drill in play. Its power cannot be used
this Combat. If it is an Ally, it cannot
take control of Combat this Combat.
Endurance 2. POWER: Your physical attacks
do +2 stages of damage this Combat. If used by
a Personality with "Android" in its title, all your
attacks do +2 life cards of damage instead.
(Limit 1 per deck.) POWER: No player
may gain anger this Combat. Shuffle
this card into your Life Deck after use.
POWER: For this Combat, each successful attack
allows its performer to capture a Dragon Ball.
In place of an attack, you may place an Ally
from your hand in play at 3 stages above 0.
POWER: Lower your opponent's anger 2
levels, or discard a Setup or Drill in play.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Use during any Planning Step.
Each player may search their Life Deck for up
to 2 Allies. Then all players reveal those Allies
and put them in their hands. Banish after use.
Endurance 3. POWER: Search your
Life Deck for a Drill and place it in play.
Chi-Chi only. POWER: Your opponent discards
the top 3 cards of their Life Deck and their Main
Personality loses 4 stages. Banish after use.
POWER: For the rest of the game, when your
opponent plays a physical or energy attack from
their hand, you may stop it by discarding a copy
of that card from your hand. Banish after use.
